caption.text:
We are honored to release The Lost Horses: Hope Still Runs in Me, narrated by New York Times bestseller Atticus with an original poem he wrote for the campaign.

This film follows the life of a horse torn from his family.  A horse who gifts loyalty and labor, only to be trailed to an auction, and pulled into an endless cycle in which these iconic animals are used and discarded... lost into the dark.

And yet for this horse... something powerful still endures.

Hope.

Atticus wrote this poem for the countless horses who move through the pipeline every day - who still carry dignity, spirit, and the indomitable will to keep going.

Please watch, share, and help us shine a light, so we can make change together.  Take two minutes of your time and lend your voice by taking action at losthorses.org

For no horse deserves to be lost again. 

Thank you, @atticuspoetry 

#TheLostHorses #WildBeautyFoundation #AtticusPoetry
